d: Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market for Lucidya's AI Unit. The AI Unit ships fast and plans in short cycles to keep pace with a rapidly changing market. This role ensures that every release is clearly positioned, well understood by our internal teams, and adopted by our customers.

You will report into the Director of Product Marketing and Customer Marketing while working day to day with the AI Unit. You will be the bridge between the team building our AI capabilities and the people who sell, support, and use them.
q: 3+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS
Experience marketing AI, machine learning, or data products
A track record of running successful product launches in a fast-moving environment
Ability to understand technical concepts and explain them simply
Comfort working across teams and managing multiple releases at once
Ability to adapt quickly as plans and priorities change
Experience in customer experience, or marketing technology
Arabic and English fluency is a must
r: Partner with the AI Unit to stay ahead of its monthly release plans and turn them into a clear launch calendar
Define launch tiers and plan the right level of go-to-market activity for each release
Lead launches end to end, from messaging and enablement to customer announcements and post-launch reporting
Develop positioning and messaging for AI capabilities that is clear, credible, and focused on customer value
Translate technical features into outcomes that resonate with Support, CX, marketing, and business leaders
Keep messaging consistent across the website, sales materials, product content, and campaigns
Build and maintain enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, demo narratives, FAQs, and battle cards
Run enablement sessions so Sales and Customer Success can confidently explain and sell new AI capabilities
Work with Customer Marketing to drive adoption of AI features among existing customers
Track the AI and Agentic CX landscape, including competitor moves and emerging trends
Gather customer and prospect feedback and share insights with the AI Unit and Product teams
Help shape priorities by bringing the voice of the market into planning discussions
Define and track success metrics for launches, including awareness, pipeline influence, and feature adoption
Report results to the Director of Product Marketing and Customer Marketing and AI Unit leadership

d: Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.
r: We’re looking for a Senior CRM & Lifecycle Specialist to own and optimize the B2B merchant lifecycle in the UAE. You will be responsible for improving conversion rates across every step of the partner journey, from new sign-ups to transacting merchants, and for driving product adoption and retention via personalized, data-driven lifecycle campaigns.

This is a highly cross-functional role that collaborates closely with the Product, Data, Content, and Performance teams. You will own CRM strategy, campaign logic, segmentation, and performance, while coordinating execution with our CRM agency.
Lifecycle Strategy: Design full-funnel lifecycle journeys to convert leads, drive adoption of Tamara’s products, and ensure merchant retention.
Funnel Optimization: Own conversion metrics across CRM stages (KYB In Progress, Qualified, Live, Transacting) and reduce drop-off at each step.
Journey Execution Oversight: Coordinate with the CRM agency to deploy journeys across the different channels and optimize performance.
Event & Data Logic: Collaborate with Product and Data teams to define and improve CRM events, and triggers.
CRM Hygiene & Integration: Maintain CRM data health and resolve issues like duplicate users, invalid events, or broken journeys if they arise.
Segmentation & Rules: Own segmentation criteria, lifecycle rules, and eligibility logic across the funnel and countries.
Testing & Reporting: Run A/B tests on messaging, frequency, and touchpoints. Define success metrics and build dashboards to monitor CRM performance.
Placement Optimization: Work with Product to introduce new CRM placements inside the Partner Portal and onboarding experience.
Complex CRM Logic Implementation: Expertly configure and maintain advanced CRM logic using dynamic content, Liquid logic, webhooks, and connected content to deliver hyper-personalized experiences.
Technical Execution: Independently manage complex workflows, event integrations, CRM system configurations, and troubleshooting when needed.
Tool Familiarity: Experience with tools such as Braze, MoEngage, Mandrill & Creatio.
HTML Knowledge: Familiarity with HTML is a plus.
4+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation (B2B, SaaS, fintech, or marketplaces preferred).
Strong track record improving conversion rates and funnel velocity through CRM programs.
Data-driven mindset with working knowledge of UTM frameworks, segmentation, and marketing attribution.
Comfort working with technical teams on events, APIs, and CRM system logic.
Success in this role will be measured by
Reduced lifecycle drop-offs and increased velocity to first transaction.
Uplift in transaction volumes due to CRM journeys.
CRM data accuracy and reduced duplication/errors.
Volume and learnings from lifecycle experiments.
